## What changed

Describe the page, record, source or technical change.

## Evidence and precision

- [ ] Factual claims are tied to visible sources.
- [ ] Allegations, analysis and adjudicated findings remain clearly separated.
- [ ] Court directions are not described as final findings unless the order says so.
- [ ] No private identifiers, credentials or unredacted sensitive records were added.

## Publishing checks

- [ ] I reviewed the Cloudflare preview on desktop and mobile.
- [ ] Navigation, source links and downloads work.
- [ ] Canonical URL, title, description, Open Graph/X metadata and JSON-LD are correct.
- [ ] The page has one clear H1 and meaningful image alt text.

## Release

Merge only after the `Site quality gate` passes and the preview has been reviewed.
